4. DRILLING EVENTS / REMARKS
1. WELLBORE INSTABILITY at 3,094 m MD (KOPILI) | Severity: MEDIUM | NPT: 5.5 hrs | MW: 12.1 ppg
Large cavings at shakers while drilling Kopili at 3,094 m MD; erratic torque and 3 m fill on bottom
after trip.
Mitigation: Raised MW by 0.3 ppg, minimised open-hole time and controlled tripping speeds.
Lesson: Minimise open-hole time in Kopili; shale destabilises within days.
2. KICK at 3,112 m MD (KOPILI) | Severity: CRITICAL | NPT: 46.0 hrs | MW: 12.1 ppg
Well kicked at 3,112 m MD on entering Kopili shale; pit gain 18 bbl, SIDPP 620 psi, SICP 780 psi. Gas
units peaked at 1,450. Influx circulated out via driller's method.
Mitigation: Shut in well on annular preventer, circulated kick out via driller's method and raised
MW from 12.1 to 13.0 ppg.
Lesson: Raise MW before the Kopili transition; overpressure onset is sharp in this field.
5. LESSONS LEARNED
 Minimise open-hole time in Kopili; shale destabilises within days.
 Raise MW before the Kopili transition; overpressure onset is sharp in this field.
